facts.en: Completed a diploma in Cultural Administration at Fictional Institute D068 in 2020; only the completion year is recorded.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D068 完成文化行政专科学历；仅记录完成年份。

facts.en: Worked as a programme desk assistant at Fictional Memory Centre D068 from 2021 to 2025; start and end months are not recorded.
facts.zh: 2021 至 2025 年在虚构记忆中心 D068 担任项目服务台助理；未记录起止月份。

facts.en: Began an archives programme assistant role at Fictional Local Archive E068 in 2026; the start month is not recorded and the role was current at source preparation.
facts.zh: 2026 年开始在虚构地方档案馆 E068 担任档案项目助理；未记录起始月份，来源准备时仍在任职。

facts.en: At the memory centre, maintained workshop booking lists and routed research access requests to the archivist.
facts.zh: 在记忆中心维护工作坊预约名单，并将研究访问请求转交档案员。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters and a shared calendar to track room bookings and participant reminders.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选及共享日历跟踪房间预约和参与者提醒。

facts.en: During 2024, helped the centre coordinator review 48 workshop booking records; only the project year is known.
facts.zh: 在 2024 年协助中心协调员复查 48 条工作坊预约记录；仅知项目年份。

facts.en: The team corrected 6 duplicated entries among those 48 records; this is a record-cleaning result, not increased attendance.
facts.zh: 团队修正该批 48 条记录中的 6 条重复项；这是记录清理成果，而非出席人数增长。

facts.en: In the current archive role, prepares approved public-session information and keeps venue confirmation files.
facts.zh: 在现任档案馆岗位准备获批公众活动信息，并维护场地确认文件。

facts.en: Checks access notices against archivist-approved wording and does not make independent rights decisions.
facts.zh: 根据档案员批准的措辞检查访问通知，不独立作出权利决定。

facts.en: Prepared a draft traveling-display itinerary in 2026; venue approval was pending and no tour had occurred at source preparation.
facts.zh: 在 2026 年准备巡回展示行程草稿；场地审批待定，来源准备时尚未巡展。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Story Circle V068 during 2023 and 2024 alongside centre employment; no months or weekly schedule are recorded.
facts.zh: 在记忆中心任职期间，于 2023 及 2024 年在虚构故事社团 V068 志愿服务；未记录月份或每周安排。

facts.en: For that circle, sorted donated reading sheets by topic without cataloguing archival originals.
facts.zh: 为该社团按主题整理捐赠阅读材料，未编目档案原件。

facts.en: Maintains a personal collection of fictional postcard illustrations as a hobby.
facts.zh: 以爱好方式收藏虚构明信片插图。

facts.en: The confirmed 2024 annual peak was 5 concurrent workshop booking lists; the current 2026 assignment is 2 session lists.
facts.zh: 确认的 2024 年度高峰为同时处理 5 份工作坊预约名单；现任 2026 年分工为 2 份活动名单。

facts.en: Wrote plain-language handover notes identifying confirmed arrangements and pending approvals.
facts.zh: 撰写通俗交接记录，标明已确认安排及待审批事项。

facts.en: An undated draft biography inserts 2021-01 and 2025-12 as employment boundaries, but no source supports either month.
facts.zh: 一份未注明日期的简介草稿将任职边界补为 2021-01 及 2025-12，但没有来源支持这两个月份。

facts.en: No professional archivist credential, conservation treatment or independent acquisition authority is claimed.
facts.zh: 不声称拥有专业档案员资格、修复处理或独立馆藏征集权限。

facts.en: Current duties include logging approved purchases for session materials while the manager authorizes spending.
facts.zh: 现任职责包括记录活动材料获批采购，经理负责批准开支。
